purpose: Localize the first current-parser AC1021 TABLE CadValue type-48 candidate to its exact row and cell without changing production parsing.

source.producer: Autodesk sample; exact save application/revision is not established by this trace

diagnostic.method: Temporary row/column/body/string/handle cursor logging around the existing AC1021 legacy TABLE cell parser; source instrumentation was reverted after capture.

evidence_review.authority: ODA v5.4.1 §§20.4.96.1 and 20.4.99 specify the R21 cell sequence and CadValue fields. The current parser follows that sequence for these AC1021 entities. ACadSharp at commit 3a52a52047e84670759c1f9ad3916ec3ce85ff56 follows the same candidate order; this is peer implementation evidence, not a source-span proof.
evidence_review.peer_limit: LibreDWG 0.14 identifies two ACAD_TABLE entities but retains their bodies as unknown bits, so its output does not independently identify these cell fields.
evidence_review.interpretation: The first unsupported candidate is localized to row 8/column 0 in handle 0x2856e and row 9/column 0 in handle 0x2a974. Earlier cells complete under the current candidate sequence. ODA does not document type 48, and the huge flags remain incompatible with a trustworthy CadValue interpretation. The trace does not establish whether the cause is an earlier cursor displacement, an undocumented producer profile, or malformed source data.
evidence_review.disposition: No production parser change. Keep both TABLE bodies semantically incomplete and output-gated until exact source spans or an independent producer decode resolve the preceding fields. No support claim is promoted.

fixture_policy: The external DWG is existing local sample material; no fixture was added or committed.
